text_block_list.text:
Invited by Trainer Kiryuin, I went along 
for a belated New Year's shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: You came, <username> Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry to call on you out of the 
blue like this. It's just…… there's 
something I really need to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the Kiryuin family, it's customary 
for relatives to gather and exchange 
information at the start of the year, 
but――

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And that was the very first time I 
received a compliment from my great-aunt.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"You've got the face of a true leader 
now"... she said.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
My great-aunt serves as an executive at 
the URA, and was a brilliant trainer who 
brought great pride to the Kiryuin family.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why... no matter how 
much others flattered me, she saw right 
through to my immature core and told me 
only to keep striving.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! It was only a glimpse, but... I 
believe I was able to show a performance 
worthy of my name.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
...It's all thanks to you, Trainer <username>. I 
wanted to express my gratitude today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because you, with a perspective I 
never possessed, remained by my side, I 
was able to keep moving forward without 
faltering.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly happy that Trainer <username> and I are 
peers! Let's continue to do our best 
together!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like we're both all fired up 
for the New Year!

text_block_list.name: Barker Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you two over there, that's some fine 
spirit you've got! Why not keep up the 
momentum and give it a go?

text_block_list.name: Barker Man
text_block_list.text:
――"The New Year Roof-Tile Breaking 
Contest"!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I see! That sounds like it'll really get 
you fired up!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It brings back memories... of the 
days when I practiced karate!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!!

Kiryuin's spirited battle cry and the 
sharp crack of breaking tiles echoed 
across the January sky—

...Somehow, I felt like Trainer Kiryuin 
and I would be able to grow even closer 
from now on.
